## Hypothesis

The HTF-gated directional scoring in Shotgun Scalper Stage-4 aims to improve edge by only allowing trades when higher timeframe (e.g., 15m/30m) structure aligns with the entry signal bias. This filters countertrend noise during choppy regimes while capturing strong directional moves. The edge exists because HTF alignment increases the probability of sustained moves, improving win rate and profit factor on qualifying setups.

## Mechanism

Entry trigger: Original Shotgun Scalper signal (volume surge + price rejection at HTF support/resistance) fires ONLY when:
- 15m EMA (fast) > 15m SMA (slow) for longs OR < for shorts (trend alignment)
- OR 30m close > 30m open for longs OR < for shorts (close-based alignment)
Exit: 
- TP1: exit 2/3 position at +75% premium (tp_premium_pct=0.75)
- Stop: exit remaining at -35% premium (stop_premium_pct=-0.35) OR 12-minute time stop (time_stop_min=12)
- Chandelier profit-lock arms at +60% premium (chandelier_arm_pct=0.6) trailing 15% off HWM
- Strike: ATM + 2 (strike_offset=2)
- Volume filter: vol_ratio_threshold=1.2 (current 3-bar avg volume > 1.2x 20-bar avg)
